fields.gap: The 1 percent-per-day budget equals a 2.48 mm2 choked hole or 4.25 mm2 molecular aperture: vacuum integrity at this budget is a discrete-defect and detection problem, not a material one. No leak specification, no detection threshold, no in-service pressure telemetry is defined.
fields.direction: Set an operational leak spec well inside 46.28 Pa m3/s with margin; specify seam leak testing per panel at assembly and a pressure sensor resolution able to see a fraction of the budget.
fields.effect: Detection latency decides whether the trim pump is a convenience or a life-limit.
